editor_chirho.page_description_chirho: Edit and recover your private Perffection page draft.
editor_chirho.not_saved_page_title_chirho: Not saved — Edit your page — Perffection
editor_chirho.status_conflict_chirho: Not saved — a newer version exists
editor_chirho.import_review_notice_chirho: This content came from the page document you pasted. Review it carefully. Your current saved version stays unchanged until you choose Save private draft, which creates a new private version.
editor_chirho.lede_chirho: Start with the few details a customer needs. Saving changes the private draft only; publishing is a separate reviewed step.
editor_chirho.validation_body_chirho: Nothing was saved. Your words are still in the form below; fix these and save again.
editor_chirho.business_name_help_chirho: The public name customers already know.
editor_chirho.headline_help_chirho: One clear promise, without a slogan nobody would say aloud.
editor_chirho.summary_help_chirho: A short answer to who you help, what you do, and where you work.
editor_chirho.services_help_chirho: Complete at least the first service. Leave unused pairs blank.
editor_chirho.contact_section_intro_chirho: Use only details you intend to make public on the finished page.
editor_chirho.contact_method_help_chirho: Add a phone number, an email address, or both. You do not need to publish both.
editor_chirho.contact_phone_title_chirho: 7 to 15 digits; you may use spaces, dashes, dots, brackets and a leading +
editor_chirho.contact_phone_help_chirho: Customers can tap this number to call you.
editor_chirho.contact_email_help_chirho: Customers can tap this address to write to you.
editor_chirho.contact_details_help_chirho: Optional: opening hours, service area, or what customers should expect.
editor_chirho.save_boundary_chirho: Saving creates a new private version. It does not publish or replace a live page.
editor_chirho.history_intro_chirho: The 16 most recent private versions are kept. Restoring adds a new version instead of overwriting the current one.
editor_chirho.history_unknown_chirho: Your saved versions are unchanged. They are listed here again after the next successful save.
editor_chirho.history_empty_chirho: Your first saved version will appear here.
editor_chirho.unavailable_safety_chirho: No change was submitted. Your current private version remains in place.
editor_chirho.conflict_attempted_template_chirho: Someone saved version {version_chirho} while you were editing, so your words were not saved. They are still in the form below and the newest saved version is in the history. Save again to make yours the newest version.
editor_chirho.conflict_head_template_chirho: Someone saved version {version_chirho} before your request, so nothing was changed. Review the newest version below and choose again.
editor_chirho.unverifiable_status_chirho: The private draft could not be verified. No change was submitted.
editor_chirho.help_heading_chirho: Need help with your private draft?
editor_chirho.help_body_chirho: Your saved versions remain private and recoverable here. If something looks wrong, open Help from the top of this page; never paste a password or access code into a message, and describe only what you can see.

guided_chirho.choose_heading_chirho: How would you like to fill this in?
guided_chirho.choose_body_chirho: Nothing here is a test. Take one thing at a time, or see every field at once. Both save the same page, and switching never loses what you typed.
guided_chirho.still_needed_chirho: A few answers from the earlier steps are still missing. They are shown above, and Save takes you to the first one.
guided_chirho.name_intro_chirho: The name customers already use for you.
guided_chirho.headline_heading_chirho: What is the one thing a visitor should know?
guided_chirho.headline_intro_chirho: One clear promise, in words you would say aloud.
guided_chirho.summary_heading_chirho: Who do you help, and where?
guided_chirho.summary_intro_chirho: Two or three plain sentences: what you do, for whom, and where you work.
guided_chirho.example_headline_chirho: e.g. Fresh bread every morning, baked before sunrise
guided_chirho.example_summary_chirho: e.g. A small family bakery on Mill Street. We bake sourdough and rye in small batches every morning, and most days we sell out by noon.

example_services_chirho.body_chirho: e.g. Sourdough and rye, out of the oven at seven.
e.g. Made to order with a week's notice. Tell us the occasion.
e.g. Espresso, cinnamon buns and whatever is still warm.

guided_chirho.example_contact_details_chirho: e.g. Open Tuesday to Saturday, 7 to 2. Next to the post office.

import_chirho.page_description_chirho: Review page content from an exported Perffection page document without changing the saved version.
import_chirho.lede_chirho: Paste an exported Perffection page document to review its content in your editor. Reviewing makes no change to your saved page.
import_chirho.panel_intro_chirho: Use the JSON text from a Perffection page-document export. The document supplies page content only.
import_chirho.document_help_chirho: Paste no more than 16 KiB. The complete document is checked before it can open in the editor.
import_chirho.review_boundary_chirho: Reviewing opens the pasted content in the editor and does not save it. Nothing changes until you explicitly choose Save private draft there; that save creates a new private version.
import_chirho.invalid_form_notice_chirho: The import form was incomplete or not recognized. Nothing was saved.
import_chirho.invalid_json_notice_chirho: The pasted text is not valid JSON. Check that you copied the complete page document. Nothing was saved.
import_chirho.unsupported_schema_notice_chirho: This JSON is not a supported Perffection PageDocumentV2 export. Nothing was saved.
import_chirho.document_too_large_notice_chirho: The page document is larger than 16 KiB. Paste a smaller exported document. Nothing was saved.
import_chirho.unreadable_body_chirho: The submitted form could not be safely read, so none of it is displayed. Nothing was saved. Reopen a blank form and paste the page document again.
import_chirho.unavailable_body_chirho: Your current saved version could not be verified, so the import form is not available. Nothing was changed.
import_chirho.help_body_chirho: This importer handles only the page content in a Perffection page document. Your saved version remains unchanged until you explicitly save from the editor.

export_chirho.page_description_chirho: Copy or download the exact saved document used for reviewed publication.
export_chirho.nothing_saved_status_chirho: Save a private draft first. Your page document appears here after the first save.
export_chirho.unverifiable_status_chirho: Your saved page could not be verified, so nothing was exported.
export_chirho.lede_chirho: This is the exact text of your saved page, in the form we publish. Nothing here is public: we publish only a document you send us, and we confirm the web address with you.
export_chirho.panel_heading_chirho: Send us this document to publish it
export_chirho.panel_intro_chirho: Download the file, or select the text and copy it, then send it to us the way we agreed when we set up your access. Keep editing meanwhile; only the version you send is published.
export_chirho.document_help_chirho: Plain text. It contains only what you typed into your page.
export_chirho.help_body_chirho: This download contains your public page words, not your password or access code. If you are unsure where to send it, read Help from the top of this page before sharing it.

publication_chirho.page_description_chirho: What is live, what is on its way, and what we could not publish.
publication_chirho.lede_chirho: Only a version you approve is published. This page shows what is live at your address, what is on its way, and anything we could not publish, in plain words.
publication_chirho.status_unavailable_chirho: Your publishing record could not be verified, so nothing is shown.
publication_chirho.address_tried_note_chirho: A name you asked for. It is not your address.
publication_chirho.not_published_body_chirho: Your page stays private until you approve a version for publication.
publication_chirho.pending_body_chirho: A version you approved is being published. This usually takes about a minute; reload to see it go live.
publication_chirho.history_intro_chirho: Every publication, republication and rollback, newest first.
publication_chirho.history_empty_chirho: Nothing has been published for this address yet.
publication_chirho.refusal_slug_reserved_chirho: That address is reserved. Choose another.
publication_chirho.refusal_slug_taken_chirho: Someone else already uses that address. Choose another.
publication_chirho.refusal_not_your_app_chirho: That address belongs to a different account.
publication_chirho.refusal_unknown_prior_params_chirho: That earlier version is not one of this address’s own published versions, so it could not be restored.
publication_chirho.refusal_unknown_template_chirho: Our page design was not available to publish with. Nothing changed; please try again later.
publication_chirho.refusal_intent_invalid_chirho: The publication request could not be verified. Nothing changed.
publication_chirho.refusal_params_missing_chirho: The approved version could not be found. Nothing changed.
publication_chirho.refusal_template_not_deployable_chirho: Our page design was not ready to publish with. Nothing changed; please try again later.
publication_chirho.refusal_unknown_chirho: We could not publish that version. Nothing changed.
publication_chirho.door_refusal_base_moved_chirho: Your address changed after you opened the publishing page. Look at what is live now, then approve again.
publication_chirho.door_refusal_version_stale_chirho: Your page was saved again after you looked at it. Open the publishing page again and approve the version you want.
publication_chirho.door_refusal_no_saved_version_chirho: There is no saved version to publish yet. Save your page first.
publication_chirho.door_refusal_not_a_document_chirho: The saved version could not be read as a page. Save your page again, then approve it.
publication_chirho.door_refusal_request_invalid_chirho: That request could not be read. Open the publishing page again and retry; nothing was sent.
publication_chirho.retention_note_chirho: A published version becomes a public record. Rolling back changes what is live; it does not erase what was published.
publication_chirho.help_body_chirho: Publishing changes only what customers see at your address. Your private drafts and saved versions stay private. If something here looks wrong, open Help from the top of this page.
publication_chirho.form_intro_chirho: Choose the address customers will use. Only the version you have saved is published, exactly as you see it in the preview.
publication_chirho.address_refused_heading_chirho: Your page is not published yet
publication_chirho.address_refused_body_chirho: The address name you chose could not be used, so nothing went live. Your saved page is unchanged; choose another name below.
publication_chirho.slug_help_chirho: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, up to 48 characters. Your site will live under this name.
publication_chirho.slug_title_chirho: 1 to 48 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, not starting or ending with a dash
publication_chirho.consent_template_chirho: Publishing makes version {version_chirho} public at {address_chirho}. It stays a public record even if you roll back later.
publication_chirho.saved_version_template_chirho: Saved version {version_chirho} is ready to publish.
publication_chirho.saved_version_live_template_chirho: Saved version {version_chirho} is what is live.
publication_chirho.saved_version_pending_template_chirho: Saved version {version_chirho} is on its way.
publication_chirho.review_link_label_chirho: Look at the saved version first
publication_chirho.operator_publish_body_chirho: Until publishing from this page arrives, send us the document from “Copy my page document” and we publish it for you.
publication_chirho.live_is_saved_template_chirho: Version {version_chirho} is what is live at this address. Save a new version to publish it again.
publication_chirho.pending_wait_chirho: While a version is on its way, wait for it to go live before approving another.
publication_chirho.editor_pointer_template_chirho: Saved version {version_chirho} is ready. Choose your address and publish it from the Publishing page, which also shows what is live.
publication_chirho.intent_page_description_chirho: The outcome of your publishing request.
publication_chirho.queued_heading_chirho: Your version is on its way
publication_chirho.queued_body_template_chirho: Version {version_chirho} is queued for {address_chirho}. It usually goes live within a minute; the publishing page shows it the moment it does.
publication_chirho.queued_rollback_body_chirho: Your earlier version is queued to become the live one again. It usually takes about a minute; the publishing page shows it the moment it does.
publication_chirho.rejected_heading_chirho: We could not send that request
publication_chirho.invalid_slug_notice_chirho: The address name must be 1 to 48 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, and must not start or end with a dash.
publication_chirho.nothing_saved_notice_chirho: Save a version of your page before publishing it.
publication_chirho.unknown_request_notice_chirho: That request could not be read. Open your page again and retry; nothing was sent.
publication_chirho.invalid_rollback_notice_chirho: That earlier version could not be identified. Open the publishing page again and choose it from the list.

account_chirho.lede_chirho: Your account lives here. Anything you can change about it is listed below.
account_chirho.held_heading_chirho: Changing your password yourself arrives soon
account_chirho.held_body_chirho: Until then, Help at the top of this page explains what you can do. When a password is reset, every signed-in session ends and you sign in again with the new one.
account_chirho.password_intro_chirho: Enter the password you use now and the new one. Every signed-in session ends the moment it changes, and you sign in again with the new one.
account_chirho.new_password_help_chirho: At least {min_characters_chirho} characters. A short sentence you will remember works well.
account_chirho.password_boundary_chirho: Changing it signs you out everywhere, including here.
account_chirho.refusal_credential_mismatch_chirho: The current password did not match. Try again.
account_chirho.refusal_credential_too_weak_chirho: The new password is too short. Use at least {min_characters_chirho} characters.
account_chirho.refusal_request_invalid_chirho: That request could not be read. Reload this page and try again.
account_chirho.refusal_change_failed_chirho: We could not change it just now. Please try again later.
account_chirho.refusal_consent_missing_chirho: Tick the box to confirm you understand this cannot be undone, then try again.
account_chirho.refusal_publication_pending_chirho: A publication request for your page is still in progress. Wait for it to finish, check the Publishing page, then try closing your account again.
account_chirho.refusal_close_failed_chirho: We could not close your account just now. Nothing changed. Please try again later.
account_chirho.refusal_recovery_failed_chirho: We could not make a recovery code just now. Nothing changed. Please try again later.
account_chirho.recovery_intro_chirho: A recovery code lets you get back in if you forget your password, without email. It is shown once; making a new one retires the old one.
account_chirho.recovery_boundary_chirho: Write it down somewhere safe before you leave the page.
account_chirho.recovery_submit_chirho: Show me a new recovery code
account_chirho.close_intro_chirho: Closing your account ends every session, removes your password and your private drafts, and takes your published address down. What was published stays a public record.
account_chirho.close_consent_label_chirho: I understand this cannot be undone.
account_chirho.close_boundary_chirho: This is final. Copy your page document first if you want to keep it.
account_chirho.help_body_chirho: If you cannot sign in, the public Help page explains what to do. We never ask for your password by email or message.

connections_chirho.intro_chirho: Connect an AI assistant you already use, such as Claude, and it can help you with your page.
can_items_chirho: Save a new private draft when you ask it to
Show you that draft the way visitors would see it
never_items_chirho: Publish anything. Publishing stays your own click.
Change your password or your account
See or change your other connections
connections_chirho.held_chirho: Connecting an assistant is not open yet. When it is, you will set it up here and can disconnect it at any time.
connections_chirho.unavailable_chirho: Your connections cannot be shown right now. Nothing about them has changed. Please try again shortly.
connections_chirho.disconnect_boundary_chirho: Disconnecting stops that assistant at once. Everything it saved for you stays exactly as it is.
connections_chirho.ended_notice_chirho: Disconnected. That assistant can no longer use anything you allowed it.
connections_chirho.refusal_no_such_key_chirho: That connection had already ended, or it is not one of yours. Nothing changed.
connections_chirho.refusal_failed_chirho: Disconnecting did not go through. Nothing changed. Please try again.

action_labels_chirho.page-draft-chirho: Everything in your workspace (an older kind of connection)

connections_chirho.connect_note_chirho: On the next page you enter your password again and choose what it may do: read your saved page, preview it, or save a new private draft. A connection lasts 30 days, and its key is shown to you once.

figures_chirho.page_description_chirho: Your own monthly figures and what they say about which work pays its way. Private to you.
figures_chirho.lede_chirho: Bring your monthly totals by kind of work and see which work pays its way. Only you can see them.
figures_chirho.unavailable_chirho: Your saved figures cannot be shown right now. Nothing about them has changed. Please try again shortly.
figures_chirho.report_intro_chirho: Worked out from your saved figures only. Nothing here is a forecast or advice, and nothing here is ever published.
figures_chirho.flag_negative_margin_chirho: Costs more than it brings in.
figures_chirho.flag_falling_share_chirho: A smaller share of your money in, in the latest month, than before.
figures_chirho.flag_costs_unknown_chirho: Costs are missing for some months, so its costs and margin are unknown.
figures_chirho.flag_gap_in_months_chirho: These months are missing from your figures altogether.
figures_chirho.incomplete_note_chirho: Some kinds of work have no figures for some months, so totals and shares are of the figures you gave, and no trend is drawn.
figures_chirho.paste_intro_chirho: Paste them as CSV, one line per month and kind of work. You will see exactly what will be kept before anything is saved.
figures_chirho.csv_help_chirho: The first line must be: month,kind,money_in,costs,jobs. Months look like 2026-01. Amounts look like 1200.50, with no currency sign. Leave costs or jobs empty when you do not know them.
figures_chirho.file_intro_chirho: The same columns, from a spreadsheet saved as CSV. What you pasted above is left as it is. You will see exactly what will be kept before anything is saved.
figures_chirho.file_help_chirho: The same first line as above, at most 64 KB.
figures_chirho.currency_help_chirho: The three-letter code, such as USD or EUR.
figures_chirho.source_note_help_chirho: For example: from my bookkeeping export. Up to 120 characters.
figures_chirho.review_lede_chirho: This is exactly what will be kept. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
figures_chirho.combined_line_chirho: lines for the same month and kind of work, added together:
figures_chirho.nothing_kept_heading_chirho: Nothing can be kept from this
figures_chirho.save_boundary_chirho: Saving keeps a new private version of your figures. It never changes your page and never publishes anything.
figures_chirho.saved_notice_chirho: Saved. These are your figures now.
figures_chirho.conflict_notice_chirho: Your figures were saved somewhere else first, so yours were not saved. Here are the saved ones; review yours again to save over them.
figures_chirho.unknown_notice_chirho: We could not confirm whether that save went through. Your saved figures are shown as they stand; check them before saving again.
figures_chirho.help_body_chirho: Only you can see your figures. They are kept apart from your page and never published.
figures_chirho.refusal_empty_chirho: There was nothing to read. Paste your figures, starting with the header line.
figures_chirho.refusal_too_large_chirho: That is more than can be read at once (64 KB). Use fewer lines.
figures_chirho.refusal_too_many_rows_chirho: That is more than 1,000 lines. Paste fewer lines.
figures_chirho.refusal_wrong_header_chirho: The first line must be exactly: month,kind,money_in,costs,jobs
figures_chirho.refusal_no_rows_kept_chirho: None of the lines could be read. Each one is listed below with its reason.
figures_chirho.refusal_too_many_months_chirho: Too many months for one save: up to 24.
figures_chirho.refusal_too_many_kinds_chirho: Too many kinds of work for one save: up to 12.
figures_chirho.refusal_currency_chirho: The currency must be a three-letter code, such as USD.
figures_chirho.refusal_unsupported_currency_chirho: That currency is not supported yet. Use one with cents, such as USD, EUR, GBP or CAD.
figures_chirho.refusal_incomplete_shape_chirho: Every kind of work and every month needs a money-in figure, and costs or jobs need money in beside them.
figures_chirho.refusal_note_chirho: The note can be up to 120 characters, on one line.
figures_chirho.refusal_amount_out_of_range_chirho: An amount or a number of jobs is too large, even after lines were added together.
figures_chirho.refusal_unreadable_form_chirho: That form could not be read. Go back to your figures and try again.
figures_chirho.refusal_file_and_paste_chirho: That form carried both a file and pasted figures. Send one of them: the file, or what you pasted.
figures_chirho.refusal_empty_file_chirho: The file you chose is empty.
figures_chirho.refusal_file_not_text_chirho: That file is not a text CSV file. Save it from your spreadsheet as CSV (UTF-8) and choose it again.
figures_chirho.refusal_other_chirho: These figures cannot be kept as they are.
figures_chirho.row_wrong_column_count_chirho: does not have the five columns. Is there a comma inside a name? Put that name in quotes.
figures_chirho.row_unclosed_quote_chirho: has a quote that is never closed.
figures_chirho.row_malformed_quote_chirho: has a quote in the wrong place. Put the whole name in quotes, and write a quote inside it as two quotes.
figures_chirho.row_invalid_month_chirho: has a month that is not like 2026-01.
figures_chirho.row_invalid_kind_chirho: has no kind of work, or one longer than 60 characters.
figures_chirho.row_invalid_money_in_chirho: has money in that is not a plain amount like 1200.50.
figures_chirho.row_invalid_costs_chirho: has costs that are not a plain amount like 400.25.
figures_chirho.row_invalid_jobs_chirho: has a number of jobs that is not a whole number.

draft_chirho.page_description_chirho: Tell us about your business in your own words and get a first draft of your page to review.
draft_chirho.lede_chirho: Tell us about your business in your own words. Our writing helper drafts a first version of your page; you review every line and nothing is saved until you save it.
draft_chirho.held_body_chirho: Until it does, start from a blank page in your editor; everything else works the same.
draft_chirho.panel_intro_chirho: Plain sentences are best. The helper only uses what you write here; it does not invent prices, claims or reviews.
draft_chirho.about_help_chirho: A few sentences: what you offer, what you are known for, how long you have been at it.
draft_chirho.audience_help_chirho: For example: homeowners and small shops in and around Mesa.
draft_chirho.services_label_chirho: Up to three services to list
draft_chirho.services_help_chirho: Short names; the helper writes a line for each.
draft_chirho.contact_method_help_chirho: Give customers one way to reach you: a phone number, an email, or both.
draft_chirho.contact_phone_help_chirho: Copied exactly as you type it.
draft_chirho.contact_details_label_chirho: Hours, or how to reach you
draft_chirho.contact_details_help_chirho: For example: weekdays 8 to 5, same-day replies.
draft_chirho.boundary_chirho: The helper writes one draft from what you put here. It costs you nothing to try, we cap what it can use, and nothing is saved until you save it.
draft_chirho.has_page_heading_chirho: Your page already has a saved version
draft_chirho.has_page_body_chirho: A first draft would only replace what you wrote. Keep editing in your editor; you can rewrite any part there.
draft_chirho.rejected_body_chirho: Nothing was sent and nothing was charged. Your words are still in the form below; fix these and send it again.
draft_chirho.notice_unreadable_chirho: The brief could not be read. Open it again and retry; nothing was sent.
draft_chirho.notice_name_missing_chirho: Tell us the name of your business.
draft_chirho.notice_about_missing_chirho: Tell us a little about what you do.
draft_chirho.notice_contact_missing_chirho: Add a phone number or an email before you send this.
draft_chirho.notice_too_long_chirho: One of the answers is longer than the page can hold. Shorten it and retry.
draft_chirho.not_drafted_heading_chirho: The helper could not draft a page this time
draft_chirho.not_drafted_body_chirho: Nothing was saved. You can try the brief again, or start from a blank page in your editor.
draft_chirho.review_notice_chirho: This draft came from the writing helper and your brief. Review every line; delete anything that is not true. Nothing is saved until you choose Save private draft.
draft_chirho.dropped_contact_notice_chirho: The helper copied your phone or email in a way that was not usable, so that field was left blank. Type yours exactly as customers should see it.
draft_chirho.refusal_over_ceiling_chirho: Your brief needs more than the helper may use in one go. Shorten it and try again; nothing was charged.
draft_chirho.refusal_provider_unavailable_chirho: The writing helper is not available right now. Try again later; nothing was charged.
draft_chirho.refusal_timeout_chirho: The writing helper took too long. Try again; nothing was charged.
draft_chirho.refusal_unparseable_chirho: The writing helper answered with something that is not a page. Try again; nothing was charged.
draft_chirho.refusal_insufficient_credit_chirho: This account has no credits for the writing helper, so it did not draft anything. Building your page costs nothing: you can write it yourself in the editor.
draft_chirho.refusal_unknown_chirho: The writing helper could not draft this time. Nothing was charged or saved.
draft_chirho.unavailable_body_chirho: Your page could not be verified, so nothing is shown. Nothing changed.
draft_chirho.help_body_chirho: Every word of the draft is yours to change in the editor before it is saved or published. If the draft says something untrue, delete it; the helper only had your brief to go on.

validation_chirho.services_required_message_chirho: Add at least one service, with a title and a description.
validation_chirho.service_pair_incomplete_message_chirho: A service needs both a title and a description. Finish this one or clear it.
validation_chirho.contact_required_message_chirho: Add a phone number or email address.
